Continuing creates a private approved draft available from our server for 24 hours. Expiry is checked on every fetch, and scheduled cleanup removes expired records. The private reference is in the link fragment, and the continuation page has no analytics or third-party assets. Anyone with the link, QR or recovery file can read the draft. Server expiry does not erase a copy already accepted on a device.

We request no stored Responses API application state. OpenAI processing retention is separate: abuse-monitoring logs may retain content for up to 30 days by default, with exceptions described in its data controls. We do not claim zero retention or deletion of every provider copy at exactly 24 hours. App Clip data can be removed by the device; it is not permanent backup. Full-app records follow your selected local/cloud profile and existing backup settings.

Shared repayment proposals

A proposal link contains the amount, currency, and payment schedule. Anyone with the link can view the plan. Saving keeps a copy in this browser. We measure actions such as sharing and saving without sending the link or plan details to analytics.
